title: Simple Past study and game modes
brief: Two-mode home for 83 photographed verbs: large study cards and a full-viewport block-world game with hints below.

artboards.title: Split portal
artboards.tradeoff: Immediate side-by-side choice and large study preview; game requires a separate full-viewport transition

artboards.title: Stacked archive
artboards.tradeoff: Clear equal-width choices, but study preview sits below the fold

artboards.title: World gate
artboards.tradeoff: Most immersive entry, but busy backdrop competes with study text
